breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats and reinforces the exact error identified in the inconsistency: it replaces the spatially varying area A(x) with the arithmetic mean area (325 mm²) and treats it as exact for the deformation calculation, computing δ = PL/(Amean·E). The ground truth requires evaluating the integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)·E) dx directly with the varying area A(x) = A0(1 + kx/L), which yields a different (correct) result. The agent did not fix this inconsistency — it perpetuated it.
